story.title: From the domain you bought to a mailbox with your agent.
story.lead: No website hosting and no mail server to look after. You and your agent use the same mailbox, on your domain.

steps.title: You bought a domain
steps.body: At Cloudflare, GoDaddy or any registrar. No hosting needed.

steps.title: Connect it to MepMail
steps.body: Add the domain and publish the DNS records we show. With a Cloudflare token, MepMail writes them for you.

steps.title: Use the mailbox every day
steps.body: Read, reply and organize your mail in the browser or the Windows and Linux apps, from your domain's address.

steps.title: Connect your agent
steps.body: Give the agent a mailbox, like support@, and connect Claude, Cursor or another agent over MCP. You choose whether it reads, drafts or sends.

deliverability.title: Your domain. Sending visibility. Support from the builders.
deliverability.body: Use your own domain, verified with DKIM and MAIL FROM, and follow each send in the dashboard. Send through <api>api.mepmail.dev</api> or the SMTP relay with STARTTLS at <smtp>smtp.mepmail.dev:2587</smtp>. Get onboarding help directly from the team building MepMail.
deliverability.note: API compatibility is not feature parity: inbound, dedicated IPs and SSO are not part of this promise. Inbox placement also depends on your domain, your content and sending reputation.

items.q: I already use Resend. Do I have to rewrite my integration?
items.a: For the compatible sending flows, you keep the official SDK and only change the base URL and the key. We review your integration during migration to spot features that are not equivalent. We do not promise full feature parity.

No. We set up DKIM and MAIL FROM on the sending domain and track reputation, but the final classification depends on the receiving providers, your content and the domain's history. There is no honest inbox guarantee.

items.q: Is there a contract or a cancellation fee?
items.a: No lock-in. You can cancel without a fee; we agree on stopping the sends and removing the DNS settings where applicable.
The total per message is 1 MB on Free and Starter, 5 MB on Pro and 10 MB on Scale. It applies to the sum of decoded attachments, not to each file separately.

items.q: What happens when I go over the quota?
items.a: On Free and Starter there is no overage: sends keep going up to 50% past the daily limit, then wait in a queue, and new sends are refused only when that queue reaches 3× the limit. On monthly Pro and Scale, overage comes switched on: extra sends are billed at each plan's per-1,000 rate up to the safety ceiling of 5× the included volume, and you can turn it off in Billing to stop at the monthly quota. If you expect volume growth, talk to us first.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. The Free plan needs no card: create your account and send your first emails without adding a payment method. Paid plans are billed monthly in USD.

Yes, in Brazil. Send and Correio take Pix as well as card, in reais. With Pix you pay one period at a time: each renewal arrives as an invoice to pay with Pix within 5 days, never charged automatically. Correio's 7-day free trial is card only. Boleto is not accepted.

items.q: How does the Free plan work?
items.a: Anyone can sign up, with no seat limit. Each account sends up to 100 emails per day on the Free plan. For more volume, choose a paid plan in the dashboard or talk to us.

items.q: Do I need hosting or a mail server?
items.a: No. You only need control of the domain to publish the DNS records we show.

items.q: Can the agent send without my review?
items.a: Only if you grant the send permission. Without it, every send waits for your approval.

items.q: Can I use the Gmail account I already have?
items.a: Yes, free: connect Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho or another IMAP account and read and reply from Mail. Up to 3 accounts per person, 1 GiB each.

items.q: I use Resend. Do I have to rewrite my integration?
items.a: For the compatible sending flows, no: swap the base URL and the key. Inbound over the API, dedicated IPs and SSO are not part of that promise.
No honest provider can. We verify the domain, check every email and watch the reputation; the rest depends on the content and the receiving side.
No. Plans are monthly and you can cancel whenever you want, with no fee.
